reviews.text: Just had another amazing cut from Johnny! He got me in short notice, christmas eve! provided expert advice for the cut and design i got. Left feeling like im a new improved version of myself. Thank you again Johnny i really appreciate it!
reviews.author: Daniel Thompson

reviews.text: My husband and son get complimented on their clean cuts in public all the time. Johnny is a true artist and takes so much pride in his work. The family feel in the shop and positive experience is what keeps these guys coming back. Ladies get your gentleman an appointment with Johnny. You WONT be disappointed.
reviews.author: Tiffany

reviews.text: Johnny was amazing, we are traveling from Alaska and our son needed a cut we came across The Barber League and went in and asked if we could do a walk in he said he normally didn’t do walk ins but would do us and stay a little later. He did an amazing job on my son’s hair and they had a blast, then he did my beard and trimmed me up. Was a great time getting to know Johnny a little and talking all sorts of different things i recommend this place to anyone!
reviews.author: North Creative Design Co

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Northfresh Sushi fitness

reviews.text:
I had been a customer at Barber League for a couple of years, but my experience with the owner, Johnathan, has been increasingly disappointing. Initially, I enjoyed my visits, but over time, I noticed a pattern in how he treats customers. Whenever we discussed topics where our views differed, it often escalated into arguments.

During my last visit, after a few disagreements, I pointed out some issues with my haircut. Instead of responding professionally, Johnathan took it personally and became defensive, shutting me out completely. Haircuts are part of the service, and I understand they can be subjective, but when I’m paying $60, I expect a better attitude and quality of service.

I've mentioned my experience to friends, and they’ve shared similar sentiments. Many of them tried Barber League based on my recommendation but decided never to return after just one visit. If you're looking for a place with good customer service, I suggest looking elsewhere. The negative reviews about Johnathan's unprofessionalism are consistent and reflect a troubling pattern. Save your time and money!

Also no cameras. I wish he would post the footage to back exactly what I have said. Truly is shame. Do better and be better.
reviews.author: Martin Sierra
